reviews.text:
BE CAREFUL ! Bar hold by scammers friends.

I made the mistake yesterday to go to Brain dead bar (they hold well their name)

I arrived alone at the place yesterday night, people there was nice at first, they let you join them (chat, play pool etc) , and at the end of the night , when they are about to close, they forced me to pay the bill of the group around 6 people (including staff of the bar…) and I just had 3 beers ..
With the excuse that I lost 2 games of pools, very daring of them (team game by the way, I played with one of them).
Such scammer people in that place..

Trust me, If you are looking for a place to get scammed, that’s the place to go.
Even has a toilet, which is game changer. Staff are great with full strength drinks.

Patron super sympas, staff au top 👍
Et super billard 🎱

Super friendly owner, top-notch staff 👍

reviews.text: Cheep drinks and free pool, great service. Highly recommend!
I've been here many times and good service with very helpful and friendly staff, love it here! Beer and all spirits and cocktails was absolutely amazing! Highly recommend.

It is a bar with a very good atmosphere, decorated in a cool style, beautiful music.  Staff take good care of customers.  Every Saturday there will be live music.  For those who like to sit and chill, Highly recommend.
I came here and had an amazing time. The drinks were cold and tasted great. My server was Skye and she made the best mojito and long islands. And she is very fun to be around. Highly recommended.
I enjoyed my time here at this bar, good service, nice people and beer is very cold and cheap. I had fun at this bar, hope to see you guys soon ☺️

It was nice, really enjoying it here. So much fun and really happy to spend my time on this bar!
Hope to see you guys soon ! Xx
It is a very impressive tourist attraction and good service and the best place to visit at night.
Worst bar in all of Patong. Total ripoff. Girls all lie. Especially the one named Deer.
